Emraan Hashmi's 'Awarapan 2' Box Office Performance Detailed

Emraan Hashmi's film 'Awarapan 2' has achieved significant box office success, crossing Rs 130 crore worldwide within four days. The film earned Rs 91 crore in India by its extended weekend and continued to perform well on Monday, despite a reported 64 percent drop in collections. Its worldwide earnings reached Rs 130.82 crore after four days, marking it as Hashmi's highest-grossing film. The movie's performance is being compared to its predecessor and other concurrent releases.
